questions.question: Whom does Isaiah 30 rebuke the people for relying on?
options: Their idols, for protection in battle

questions.question: In what did Isaiah 30 say their strength and salvation would be found?
options: In great armies and chariots of iron
In high walls and well-stocked storehouses
In strong alliances with foreign kings
In returning and rest, in quietness and trust
questions.answer: In returning and rest, in quietness and trust

questions.question: Isaiah 30 promises that the LORD waits to be gracious and is a God of justice; blessed are those who wait for him.
In returning and rest you shall be saved; in quietness and in trust shall be your _____.
Your ears shall hear a word behind you, saying, 'This is the way, walk in _____.'
